text:
sasha: Quick heads-up — proposing an "anchor-hold" on runtime 4.2 for quant-v3/longseq workloads. We repro a kv-cache misindex on seq_len > 8k on ampere nodes (driver 535.5). Want a controlled change window tonight 02:00-03:00 UTC to apply routing and roll back if needed. Deploybot will need an anchor flag.

deploybot: (bot) New change window created: anchor-window-4777. Use `/deploybot anchor add` to apply anchors.

jamie: @sasha can you paste the top-line telemetry? Are users seeing 5xx or internal only?

sasha: Top-line: ~0.6% of requests hit kv-cache index error -> 5xx for affected endpoints, spikes during large batch inference. Crash ID crash-8857 in logs. Repro locally with longseq test harness.

arun: Let's do regional first — us-west-2 only. Apply anchor to runtime pool there and reroute traffic to runtime-4.1.2-compatible nodes. Minimizes blast radius.

maya: Ops prepared. I can push routing rule and the release-note stub. 02:00 UTC works for nightshift. Need on-call taylor to ack.

taylor: I'll be oncall. If we flip the anchor, what's the quick rollback runbook?

sasha: Rollback/runbook sketch:
1) `/deploybot anchor add runtime=4.2 region=us-west-2 reason="kv-cache longseq" actor=sasha`
2) update routing: map service=hosted-api -> runtime=4.1.2 in us-west-2 (routing rule r-9222)
3) warmup traffic 10% -> 50% -> 100% and monitor error_rate / p50-p99 latency for 15m windows
4) if error_rate <= baseline keep anchor and ship micropatch; if error_rate stays elevated, rollback routing and escalate to eng-sre
5) document anchor in release-notes and customer advisory

jamie: Note: SDK compatibility callout — SDK v3.7.8 silences the failure; SDK v3.8 surfaces it (shim removal). We should mark SDK v3.8 as incompatible with runtime 4.2 for longseq until 4.2.1 is out.

deploybot: (bot) Command executed: `/deploybot anchor add runtime=4.2 region=us-west-2 reason="kv-cache-longseq" actor=sasha` — success. Anchor ID anchor-4777-cc. Expires by default in 24h.

maya: Routing change applied (r-9222). Starting warmup: 10% -> 50% -> 100% with progressive validation.

sasha: Observability update (10m post-change): error-rate for longseq endpoints down 78%, memory reclaim stable, no new OOMs. Keeping anchor for 24h while we produce a micropatch.

arun: I'll open a PR for runtime 4.2.1: kv-cache index guard + kernel-selection fallback. Link when ready.

taylor: Oncall watching dashboards. If any unexplained p50/p99 jumps or customer alerts, I'll escalate. Ping #eng-oncall.

maya: Drafted release note entry & customer advisory for enterprise. Will attach routing IDs and anchor ID.

sasha: Thanks — leaving anchor in place until 2026-03-24T02:00Z unless we un-anchor earlier after confirmation. Postmortem + un-anchor decision will be a follow-up thread.

deploybot: (bot) Anchor anchor-4777-cc will expire at 2026-03-24T02:00Z unless extended. To extend: `/deploybot anchor extend anchor-4777-cc duration=24h`.
